answers.how: The ruler's 1 cm intervals span approximately 40 pixels. The block's front edge spans about 490 pixels, giving 490/40 ≈ 12.2 cm.
The front face is approximately 100 pixels thick. Using 40 pixels per cm gives 100/40 = 2.5 cm.
Between 2.28 s and 3.40 s, the pencil tip moves approximately 550 pixels. Its average speed is 550/(1.12 × 40) ≈ 12.3 cm/s.
During cutting, from approximately 9.12 s to 17.08 s, the saw advances about 490 pixels across the block. Using 40 pixels per cm gives 490/(7.96 × 40) ≈ 1.5 cm/s.
